panels.title: Decision Mix
panels.description: agent_decisions grouped into hourly buckets by action — proposed/hold/error mix over the dashboard time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time,
  action,
  count(*) AS decisions
FROM agent_decisions
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest Decisions
panels.description: Latest agentic decisions with plan thesis — agent_decisions joined against plan_json->>'thesis' for offline read of what the model actually reasoned.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  created_at,
  strategy_id,
  symbol,
  action,
  confidence,
  playbook_version,
  plan_json->>'thesis' AS thesis,
  rationale
FROM agent_decisions
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 25
